recovery.m5_laya: The initial full evaluation lacked safetensors. A one-model retry supplied the final Laya outcome after installing safetensors 0.8.0.
recovery.m5_placement: The original BGE and FP16 compute-plan reader returned zero inspectable operations. Only placement was re-read with the current helper. The warm timings come from the initial probe.
recovery.m4_outcomes: Five checked single-model reports, with separate times and the same dataset lock, were combined after an interrupted coordinator run. A later disk-space stop during a warm decision probe preserved the existing outcome and encoder reports.

legalbench_token_audit.method: Use the benchmark's whitespace-aware character chunks with zero overlap. Count each prefixed token sequence, including BOS and EOS once. A sequence above the cap retains the first cap minus one IDs and an EOS. Counts exclude padding.

memory_units: Decimal GB. Combined is the model process footprint plus its observed neural and model-mapped memory and any measurable ANE daemon delta. MLX is a separate allocator reading.
placement: MLComputePlan preferred operation counts, by compiled bundle and function. Other means unclassified. Counts describe the compiler plan and do not measure execution time.
comparison: Same locked data and evaluators. All native runs except refreshed Kev were retained from earlier on the same hosts. These separate timings estimate speed ratios, not interleaved promotion decisions.
